There is probably good reasons for it in terms of gameplay but given the collective mania one would think that a massively multi-player universe on the same themes would be popular? Maybe an opportunity for the #fediverse , to revive the #MUD and #MMORPG and whatnot era but with the immensely better hardware and software of today?

https://mastodon.social/@kitsunech/11766.text: This game is just disappointing start to finish. Bland BGM and level design, combat is utterly boring too. Multiple playable characters is cool but they suck and there's almost no reason not to pick Rogue. Playing this makes you want to skip as much as possible just to end it faster. Some potentially good ideas in here, none of which were realised. Skip this and Gamemaster's Legacy. I'll have to revisit the first X-Men to see if it's good enough... #retrogaming #sega #gamegear

https://mastodon.social/@geek_hobbies@pi.name: Geek Hobbies
https://mastodon.social/@geek_hobbies@pi.text: 🎮 FINISHED: DUKE NUKEM 1 - EVERCADE Unlike the most popular games in the series, this one is not an FPS, but a 2D platformer released in 1991, with that feeling of MS-DOS games from the 90s. I loved playing it on the Evercade, which lets you play it with retro graphics or the remastered version. A game divided into 3 episodes, with a good number of levels divided between them. Have you played Duke Nukem 1? If not, I recommend everyone to try this classic at least once. #finished #dukenukem #retrogaming #evercade #geekhobbies
